command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/commands?limit=1000'); Write-Output ('===== '+`$n+' ====='); `$r.commands | Where-Object { (`$_.command -match '(ping|trac|mpls|ldp|lsp|10\.3\.10|interface (Eth|Ethernet|GigabitEthernet|GE)1/0/[0-2]$|ip route)') -or (`$_.command_key -match '(ping|trac|mpls|ldp|lsp|10\.3\.10|ip_route)') } | ForEach-Object { if (`$_.command) { `$_.command } else { `$_.command_key } } }"
